description: This file declares functions, types, and macros for handling Git blob objects in the libgit2 library, including loading, creating, filtering, and analyzing blobs.

methods.name: git_blob_lookup
methods.description: Lookup a blob object from a repository using its ID.

methods.name: git_blob_lookup_prefix
methods.description: Lookup a blob object from a repository using a short ID prefix.

methods.name: git_blob_free
methods.description: Free the memory associated with a blob object.

methods.name: git_blob_id
methods.description: Get the SHA1 hash ID of a blob.

methods.name: git_blob_owner
methods.description: Get the repository that contains the blob.

methods.name: git_blob_rawcontent
methods.description: Get a read-only pointer to the raw content of a blob.

methods.name: git_blob_rawsize
methods.description: Get the size in bytes of the blob content.

methods.name: git_blob_filtered_content
methods.description: Get the filtered content of a blob, applying any relevant filters.

methods.name: git_blob_create_fromworkdir
methods.description: Create a blob from a file in the working directory.

methods.name: git_blob_create_fromdisk
methods.description: Create a blob from a file on disk.

methods.name: git_blob_create_fromchunks
methods.description: Create a blob from chunks of data provided via callback.

methods.name: git_blob_create_frombuffer
methods.description: Create a blob from an in-memory buffer.

methods.name: git_blob_is_binary
methods.description: Heuristically determine if a blob's content is binary.
